description_for_human: Biconomy is the onchain orchestration layer. Compose multi-step, cross-chain blockchain workflows — swaps, bridges, DeFi deposits, contract calls — into a single user signature across 20+ EVM chains. No smart contracts required.
description_for_model: Biconomy is the onchain orchestration layer for multi-chain applications. It lets you compose multi-step, cross-chain blockchain workflows into a single user signature — powered by the Modular Execution Environment (MEE). MEE handles sequencing, runtime parameter injection, bridge timing, gas abstraction, simulation-based async execution, and failure recovery. No smart contracts required. CORE CAPABILITIES: (1) COMPOSABLE ORCHESTRATION: Chain multiple operations where each step uses exact outputs from the previous one via runtime parameter injection. Swap USDC→WETH then deposit the exact WETH received into AAVE — no guessing amounts, no dust. MEE resolves values at execution time through simulation. Works same-chain (atomic) and cross-chain (sequential with automatic bridge waiting). (2) CROSS-CHAIN EXECUTION: Execute across multiple chains with a single signature. MEE handles bridge selection, timing, gas on destination chains, and execution ordering. Simulation-based waiting: MEE simulates next step → fails because tokens haven't arrived → waits → retries → succeeds → executes. No event listeners or callbacks needed. (3) DEFI ZAPS: One-click vault deposits and withdrawals across 200+ protocols (AAVE, Morpho, Yearn, Beefy, Compound, Lido, Curve, Convex, Uniswap LP). Use /instructions/intent-vault for lossless direct deposit/withdraw. Cross-chain zaps supported: deposit from any chain into vaults on any other chain. (4) UNIVERSAL GAS ABSTRACTION: Users never need native gas tokens. Sponsor gas entirely (omit feeToken), let users pay in any ERC-20 with liquidity (USDC, USDT, DAI, WETH, LP tokens, yield tokens, governance tokens), or pay gas cross-chain (execute on Arbitrum, pay from Base USDC). (5) SMART SESSIONS (AGENTS): Delegated execution for AI agents, bots, and automated strategies. Users grant scoped, time-limited, revocable permissions enforced onchain. Policies: getSudoPolicy (full function access), getUniversalActionPolicy (parameter-level rules with spending caps), time range, usage limit. (6) CONDITIONAL EXECUTION: Trigger transactions based on on-chain conditions — price oracles, balance thresholds, any view function result. GTE/LTE/EQ comparisons. Use upperBoundTimestamp so orders expire. (7) SWAPS & TRADING: Same-chain and cross-chain token swaps with smart order routing across 200+ DEXs and aggregators. Limit orders via conditional execution. fast-quote mode for UI previews. INTEGRATION OPTIONS: Two ways to use MEE — both share the same API key, engine, and chains. (A) Supertransaction REST API (any language): POST /v1/quote with composeFlows array → user signs payload → POST /v1/execute. (B) AbstractJS TypeScript SDK (@biconomy/abstractjs): toMultichainNexusAccount + createMeeClient + buildComposable + getQuote + executeQuote. INSTRUCTION TYPES (composeFlows array): /instructions/intent-simple (token swaps with automatic routing), /instructions/build (custom contract calls with runtimeErc20Balance for dynamic amounts), /instructions/build-raw (pre-encoded calldata), /instructions/intent (portfolio rebalancing with weighted targets), /instructions/intent-vault (DeFi zaps for 200+ protocols). ACCOUNT MODES: 'smart-account' (simplest — one signature, cross-chain gas), 'eoa' for MetaMask/Rabby (Fusion — requires fundingTokens + withdrawal instruction), 'eoa-7702' for embedded wallets like Privy/Dynamic/Turnkey (handle 412 authorization on first use). KEY ENDPOINTS: POST /v1/quote (get orchestration quote with signable payload), POST /v1/execute (submit signed quote), GET network.biconomy.io/v1/explorer/{hash} (track status). MEE Explorer: https://meescan.biconomy.io/details/{supertxHash}. RUNTIME INJECTION: Use runtimeErc20Balance (API) or runtimeERC20BalanceOf (SDK) to inject exact token balances at execution time. Constraints (greaterThanOrEqualTo, lessThanOrEqualTo) make MEE wait until values are ready — this is how cross-chain async execution works. FAILURE HANDLING: Same-chain operations are atomic (all or nothing). Cross-chain uses cleanup transactions to return funds if later steps fail. Always include cleanUps for cross-chain flows. IMPORTANT: Quotes expire in ~30 seconds. success:true from /v1/execute means accepted, NOT completed — poll status. EOA mode requires withdrawal instruction. Use fast-quote for UI previews. SUPPORTED CHAINS: Ethereum (1), Base (8453), Arbitrum (42161), Optimism (10), Polygon (137), BSC (56), Sonic (146), Scroll (534352), Gnosis (100), Avalanche (43114), plus Apechain, Hyper EVM, Sei, Unichain, Monad, and more. Audited by Cyfrin, Spearbit, Zenith, Pashov. 70M+ transactions, $3.5B+ volume. Base URL: https://api.biconomy.io
